description: List changes suppliers proposed to purchase orders, through the vendor portal (line quantities and prices) or by email (also expected dates, shipping status and tracking). Each request shows its PO, supplier, status, source, line changes (original → proposed quantity and price), proposed date and shipping values, notes, and for email-sourced requests the Signal Center card (actionItemId) that carries it. Defaults to pending requests, newest first; status=all includes reviewed ones. Optional purchaseOrder (id or number). Paged (limit default 50, max 200). review_purchase_order_change_request approves or rejects one. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

purchaseOrder.description: Optional purchase order id (GUID) or number.

status.description: pending (default), approved, rejected, superseded, stale, undone, or all.

name: list_purchase_order_change_requests
title: List PO Change Requests
